messages:
maria: Heads-up — the 'inference-integ' CI job has been red for ~40m. Mock-kafka consumer lag is spiking and tests time out. Anyone actively triaging?
ci-bot: Build 5821 failed: job inference-integ (ci-us-west). Logs: https://ci.internal/red/5821 — consumer lag + connection errors.
jian: seeing same on my PR. consumer lag hits ~1.2M offsets, offsets not committing. Not reproducing on my laptop.
rob: Not repro locally either. CI-side mock-kafka pod was upgraded ~2h ago, might be related. :thinking_face:
maria: @rob can you grab logs from the mock-kafka pod and try a quick restart? /rerun 5821 if helpful.
priya: triggered rerun 5821.1 and tagged infra folks @rob @jian — ci-bot confirmed.
ci-bot: Rerun triggered: 5821.1 — queued on runner-7.
sam: Pasting the most relevant tail from the consumer in 5821: ```ERROR ConsumerPollTimeout: timed out waiting for records after 120s
INFO 2026-03-17T15:12:34Z Commit failed: TimeoutError
WARN ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer```
rob: That looks like the broker is intermittently dropping connections. I can restart mock-kafka-test-0 now.
jian: Restarted mock-kafka-test-0 (ci-mock-namespace). Watching offsets.
ci-bot: Rerun 5821.1 completed — still flaky. New failure on job 5821.2: ConnectionResetError persists.
priya: Can we bisect recent changes? Which images/PRs went in last 3 hours? @maria want to hold merges?
maria: Putting a short merge freeze on main until we stabilize. I'll open an incident in #incidents and ping SRE. :lock:
rob: Quick mitigation: I can roll back mock-kafka image to previous tag (deployed 2h ago) while we investigate. Would that be okay?
sam: Another datapoint — redis-backed offset store on ci-mock-03 shows large backlog and some OOM events around the same time. Could be memory pressure causing brokers to drop connections.
jian: Checked node metrics: ci-mock-03 had kubelet OOMScore spikes and docker restart events at 14:50 UTC. Might be correlated.
priya: I'll open a ticket and include logs + timestamps. Ticket: https://tickets.internal/REDWOOD-3741 (created, will link more traces). Rolling back mock-kafka image now.
rob: Rollback started — switching to mock-kafka:v1.8.3-oldtag. Monitoring pods come up.
ci-bot: New build 5821.3 queued after rollback.
priya: If 5821.3 still fails, plan B: increase test timeout and add a temporary CI-only env var KAFKA_MOCK_LATENCY_DISABLE=true, but prefer rollback first.
maria: Good plan. Merge freeze remains until we confirm green and ship a postmortem. Thanks everyone for quick responses. I'll check back in 15m. :thumbsup:
